map.输入六个爻的阴阳，按《周易》规则推算本卦与变卦并给出卦辞译注，供古文学习参考。: Enter the yin/yang of the six lines, derive the original and transformed hexagrams by the Zhouyi rules and give annotated hexagram texts for classical Chinese study reference.
map.本卦+变卦解读：起卦得本卦与动爻，依“动爻数”定解读重心（无动爻看本卦卦辞、一爻: Original plus transformed hexagram reading: cast the original hexagram and the moving lines, and set the interpretive focus by the 'number of moving lines' (no moving lines reads the original hexagram text, one moving line reads that line's text, and so on).
map.爻位分析：看用爻在第几爻（初/二/三/四/五/上）及阴阳、当位（阳居阳位、阴居阴: Line position analysis: look at which line the relevant line sits in (first/second/third/fourth/fifth/top), whether it is yin or yang, and whether the position is appropriate (yang in a yang position, yin in a yin position), to judge the fortune of timing and position.
map.卦德与象数：结合上下卦卦德（乾健坤顺、坎陷离丽等）与互卦、之卦，综合给出象数层面: Hexagram virtues and image-numbers: combine the virtues of the upper and lower trigrams (Qian is active, Kun is receptive, Kan is sinking, Li is clinging and so on) with the nuclear and transformed hexagrams to give a comprehensive image-number reading.
map.以「水火既济」初爻变为例: Taking the first line change of 'water over fire, Ji Ji' as an example
map.：既济（䷾，离下坎上，水在火上）初九爻变则成水雷屯（䷂）。依古法“一爻变则看本卦: : Ji Ji (hexagram 63, Li below and Kan above, water over fire) with the first line changing becomes Shui Lei Zhun (hexagram 3). By the ancient rule 'with one line changing, read the text of the changed line in the original hexagram': Ji Ji line 1 says 'drag the wheel, wet the tail, no blame', meaning it is right to hold steady and not rush at the start. Combining the first line's 'beginning of the affair' with Ji Ji's image of 'already accomplished' gives the reading 'at the start of success one must still begin cautiously'.

map.变爻数量不同怎么解读？: How is a different number of changing lines interpreted?
map.传统《周易》占法：无变爻看本卦卦辞；一爻变看变爻爻辞；二爻变看本卦两变爻爻辞、以: Traditional Zhouyi divination: with no changing lines read the hexagram text; with one changing line read that line's text; with two read the two changing lines of the original hexagram with the upper one primary; with three read both the original and changed hexagram texts; with four read the two unchanging lines of the changed hexagram; with five read the unchanged line of the changed hexagram; with all six changing read the changed hexagram text (Qian and Kun use 'yong jiu/yong liu'). This tool locates the interpretive focus by these rules.
map.什么叫“当位”和“乘承比应”？: What do 'appropriate position' and 'supporting, bearing, comparing, corresponding' mean?
map.当位指阳爻居初/三/五（阳位）、阴爻居二/四/上（阴位）为得位，反之为失位；乘承: Appropriate position means a yang line in the first/third/fifth (yang positions) or a yin line in the second/fourth/top (yin positions); otherwise the position is lost. Supporting, bearing, comparing and corresponding describe relations between lines (bearing = lower supports upper, riding = upper overrides lower, comparing = adjacent, corresponding = first-fourth/second-fifth/third-top pairs). These are common terms in hexagram interpretation used to refine judgements of fortune.
